card.name: Scientist first names before surnames
card.fires_on: First names or initials of named astronomers and physicists, right before the surname, in space and science news. Also fires on a few odd spots in the same articles, such as a year digit or the word parameters.

modes.label: Researcher first name
modes.description: A first name after a title like researcher or astrophysicist, just before the surname.
modes.example: recalls gamma-ray-burst researcher<< Ralph>> Wijers of the University of Amsterdam

modes.label: Initial or name part
modes.description: A period after an initial, or the middle of a first name, in a credited name.
modes.example: led by Paul R<<.>> Renne, a UC Berkeley adjunct associate

modes.label: Other science-news spots
modes.description: Scattered numbers or measurement words in astronomy text.
modes.example: will be circling Saturn until at least <<2>>010.

card.writes: It pushes toward the start of a surname or name-like word and away from the word correct.
card.plain: It marks the spot in science news where a scientist's first name is about to be followed by their surname.
